name: Tsukushima Tsukushi
source:
A first-year student who attends the same school as [url=/c89999]Kuzumi Kiyoshirou[/url]. 

From the time she first laid eyes on Kuzumi, Tsukushi couldn't help but feel drawn to him. She constantly observes him from afar since her timidity prevents her from approaching him. Despite this, her desire to serve those she cares for runs deep. She is proactive in planning romantic outings and takes the initiative without hesitation.
On a side note, she has a hearty appetite and is prone to impulsive buying.

Going home style: Stalking from a distance...?
Although she is very interested in Kuzumi, she gets nervous and avoids him when she sees him, so it may be better to actively initiate a conversation with her. As she becomes more comfortable, she may approach Kuzumi on her own.
